title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.0 hits Tibet
content:
A strong earthquake of magnitude 7.0 struck Tibet on Thursday, according to seismic data. The earthquake occurred at a depth of 173 kilometres. The most recent earthquake to strike Nepal was on September 8. The earthquake came amid ongoing rescue and recovery operations following floods triggered by an ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border on August 26. The disaster swept away homes, roads and bridges, damaged hydropower projects and left thousands missing. Authorities have also raised concerns over the region’s vulnerability to extreme weather, glacier retreat and rising temperatures. Chinese researchers have warned that climate change is accelerating glacier loss across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, potentially increasing the risks of future disasters. The plateau is also the source of several major transboundary rivers, including the Brahmaputra, making environmental changes there a concern for downstream communities.

content: the ocean may owe its continued existence, at least under its present name, to Sundar Pichai . he rejected his effort to rename the ocean after himself because it touched numerous countries, not just the united states . google has not publicly confirmed Trump’s account .

content: BJP MP Nishikant Dubey alleged that opposition-led protests in India were part of a conspiracy to destabilise the country . he questioned Lok Sabha leader Rahul Gandhi’s alleged links with US lawmakers Ilhan Omar and Ro Khanna, while raising concerns over foreign funding, cryptocurrency and online gambling .

title: Brookline mansion asks $34m, could beat Tom Brady's $32.5m home sale
content: 55 Singletree Road has entered the market at $34 million . the seven-bedroom mansion is one of the most expensive residential sales the town has seen . it spans 19,138 square feet across 2.06 acres and includes seven bedrooms and 16 bathrooms .
